tools.name: screenseal_screen
tools.description: Screen a person or organization name against the current OFAC SDN, OFAC Consolidated Non-SDN, and EU financial sanctions datasets. Returns potential fuzzy matches with confidence scores, per-list provenance (list versions, source URLs, SHA-256 digests), and a cryptographic EIP-712 attestation sealin

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: screenseal_screen · Private data: screenseal_screen · Public sink: screenseal_screen.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: screenseal_screen · Private data: screenseal_screen · Public sink: screenseal_screen

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
